about.title: About Me
about.text: My name is Vojtěch Vahala and I focus on photography that captures natural emotions and authentic moments. I approach each photoshoot individually, ensuring that people feel relaxed and themselves in front of the lens. I shoot weddings, portraits, corporate events, and parties. I am based in Brno and South Moravia, but I'm always happy to travel anywhere for interesting projects.

hody.title: Moravian Feasts
hody.text: For me, Moravian feasts are not just an event, but a living tradition full of colors, emotions, and strong moments. I enjoy capturing the atmosphere of folk costumes, dancing, music, and the joy of the people who keep this tradition alive. By photographing feasts, I strive to preserve their unique character and natural energy so that the photos tell a story long after the event itself has ended.
